Name: Melissa H.
Bio: I believe in lifestyle therapy and advocate for the healing modalities of real food nutrition and mindful yoga. I support each person individually with the care and guidance they deserve to activate their mind and body's innate capacity to heal.
Services: Individual nutritional counseling (AZ, CA, CO, MI, OR, VA)

Name: Dana D.
Bio: I have a variety of experiences and areas of expertise based on my 13 years of counseling patients and families on nutrition. I support my patients (of ALL ages) in making changes at a pace that is comfortable for them and help when it's time to dig in to discover inner motivation. My patients tell me they love my conversational demeanor and practical approach to nutrition, and I thoroughly enjoy helping them discover the eating style that will help them feel comfortable, thrive in health, and succeed in all areas of life.
Services: Individual nutritional counseling (AZ, CA, CO, MA, MD, NH, NV, OR, VT)

Name: Nasira C.
Certifications: DrPH (Doctor of Public Health) in Nutrition
MPH (Master of Public Health) in Community Health Science
BS (Bachelor of Science) in Nutrition Science
BFA (Bachelor of Fine Arts) in Dance
NASM (National Academy of Sports Medicine) Certified Personal Trainer, Senior Fitness Specialist, Corrective Exercise Specialist
Bio: I was drawn to nutrition and public health as a result of my diverse background in science, fine arts, and fitness. Trained as a classical ballet dancer, I graduated Summa Cum Laude from the University of Arizona with a B.S. in Nutrition and a B.F.A. in dance. I then obtained a Master’s in Public Health from UCLA and a Doctorate in Nutritional Sciences from Loma Linda University. I am a certified personal trainer and NASM and Senior Fitness Specialist, as well as a certified yoga instructor.  In addition to being a private practice registered dietitian, I serve as the nutritionist for several local schools, dance studios, and senior community centers.
Services: Individual nutritional counseling (AZ, CA, CO, MI, VA)

Name: Brianna B.
Bio: With six years of hands-on experience, I specialize in guiding clients towards achieving their body composition and overall wellness goals through the cultivation of sustainable lifestyle choices. Tailoring my approach to meet both your needs and budget, I provide tiered packaging options for a personalized and effective wellness journey.
Services: Nutrition counseling (AZ, CA, CO, FL, MI, VA)

Name: Stephanie C.
Bio: I enjoy working with clients to develop a healthier relationship with food. My goal is to help you feel better in your body and feel nourished, energetic and satisfied. I’m also experienced with the variety of circumstances that can lead to gastric or intestinal distress. Meetings with me are conversational, relaxed and fun. In addition to basic education around nutrition principles and food selection, I use several different modalities including DBT, CBT, and exposure therapy to help you meet your goals.
Services: Individual nutritional counseling (AZ, CA, CO, GA, IL, MI, VA)

Name: Andrea G.
Certifications: MEd (Masters of Education) in Human Nutrition
Bio: I specialize in holistic nutrition & wellness plans based on your lifestyle & goals, using integrative, natural, and mind-body approaches. Together we determine realistic, attainable ways to reach your goals, using real food natural supplements, if needed. Our check-in meetings allow us to celebrate successes and modify your plan, if needed. I tailor everything for you with personalized coaching and support needed for your success.
Services: Individual nutritional counseling (AZ, CA, CO, MI, NC, VA)
